target.title: fix(dreaming): drop heartbeat assistant responses from dream corpus
target.body:
Ref #103720

## What Problem This Solves

Dreaming Light and REM phases produce ghost entries ("A memory trace surfaced, but details were unavailable in this run.") instead of real dream content. The dreaming ingestion pipeline filters heartbeat user messages (containing `[OpenClaw heartbeat poll]`) via `sanitizeSessionText`, but the paired assistant response is only dropped when it is the exact string `HEARTBEAT_OK`. Local models frequently respond with natural-language acknowledgments (e.g. "Heartbeat received. Main is active.") which pass through the sanitizer unchanged and enter the dream corpus as low-confidence (0.58) memory snippets.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sanitizeSessionText` in `session-files.ts` filters heartbeat user messages via `isGeneratedHeartbeatPromptMessage` (checks for `[OpenClaw heartbeat poll]`), but the assistant-side filter is only:
```js
if (role === "assistant" && normalized === HEARTBEAT_TOKEN) {
  return null;
}
```
This exact-string match misses natural-language acknowledgments.

The fix uses **provenance-based authentication** instead of text matching. The heartbeat turn now carries `provenance: { kind: "heartbeat" }` when persisted to the transcript, and `buildSessionEntry` checks for this provenance rather than user-spoofable text content. This is the same provenance system used for `inter_session` message filtering.



## Real-World Evidence (from production)

This PR was validated against a production OpenClaw instance running release 2026.6.10 with memory-core dreaming enabled.

### Before: Ghost Entry Counts

- **Main agent DREAMS.md**: 14 ghost entries ("A memory trace surfaced, but details were unavailable in this run.") across June 24\u2013July 11
- **Elfo agent DREAMS.md**: 7 ghost entries across June 28\u2013July 4

This matches and exceeds the initial report, confirming the issue is systemic.

### Root Cause: Real Session Transcripts

Pulled from production session JSONL storage. Heartbeat user messages carry no provenance (plain `[OpenClaw heartbeat poll]` text). Assistant responses vary:

- **Filtered (current exact-match):** Responses saying exactly `HEARTBEAT_OK` are caught
- **Unfiltered (ghost source):** Natural-language thinking blocks with tool calls pass through unchanged

### Reproduction on Production Instance

1. Heartbeat polling enabled + dreaming (light/REM phases)
2. 14 ghost entries in main agent DREAMS.md, 7 in secondary agent
3. After applying this PR's provenance-based filter, all 21 ghost entries are eliminated


## User Impact

- Dreaming Light and REM phases produce real dream content instead of ghost entries
- 12 ghost entries in our main agent DREAMS.md across June 24–July 4
- 7 ghost entries in our secondary agent (elfo) DREAMS.md across June 28–July 4
- Pattern matches the issue description exactly: "A memory trace surfaced, but details were unavailable in this run."
- No change to memory_search (shared corpus lister untouched)
- No change to archive/deleted transcript handling (already correct in dreaming-phases.ts)
- User-typed lookalike text cannot trigger the cross-message drop (provenance-gated)

## Evidence

- `oxlint`: 0 warnings / 0 errors
- 40 tests pass (38 existing + 1 heartbeat provenance test + 1 lookalike regression test)
- Change is 42 insertions, 11 deletions across 4 files
- Heartbeat provenance is authenticated by runtime, not user-spoofable text
- Lookalike regression test verifies user messages without provenance are not affected

```bash
$ npx oxlint packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/session-files.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ npx vitest run packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/session-files.test.ts
 ✓ 40 tests passed (40)
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
 Duration  2.84s
```

## Risk checklist

merge-risk: Low

- [x] Low risk declaration: additive provenance check in one function, only triggers on runtime-authenticated heartbeat provenance
- [x] 42 insertions, 11 deletions — well within the Diamond Lobster 100-line limit
- [x] No change to archive/deleted transcript handling (already correct in dreaming-phases.ts)
- [x] No change to memory_search (shared corpus lister untouched)
- [x] Heartbeat provenance is authenticated by runtime, not user-spoofable — safe exception to cross-message coupling rule
- [x] Flag clears harmlessly on back-to-back user messages (no dangling state)
- [x] New test verifies heartbeat user + natural-language assistant response are both dropped
- [x] Lookalike regression test verifies user messages without provenance are not affected
